title: the frost fog of a dry ice barrel is a thick cloud
why: Tuning of the three new barrels after the pictures (2026-10-18): the frost fog a cryo barrel leaves behind was a faint outline and one pale blob, so it did not read as a cloud of cold. It is now a thicker base, a brighter rim and six larger, denser clouds (about twice the cover), still baked sprites drawn a few times with no allocation in the frame. The check measures the cover on a recording canvas, so it holds on any machine.
now: The frost fog a dry ice barrel leaves is now a thick cloud you can read at a glance.
